title: KEPT FROM FALLING
A PRAYER OF REFUGE
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering

scenes.a: Your feet feel unsteady on this steep road.
scenes.sub: WHEN THE ROAD FEELS STEEP TODAY

scenes.a: Hear the promise in Jude one:
Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling,
scenes.sub: KEPT FROM SLIPPING IN THE VALLEY

scenes.a: and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
scenes.sub: IN THE LIGHT OF HIS PRESENCE

scenes.a: To the only wise God our Savior, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
Father, hold our steps upright whenever the heavy ground beneath us begins to tremble.
scenes.sub: HOLD US UPRIGHT THROUGH THE STORM

scenes.a: Guard our soul from slipping into fear, and carry every unseen concern in Your hands. You remain our safe refuge both today and forever. Amen. Your feet feel unsteady on this steep road.
scenes.sub: OUR SAFE REFUGE TODAY AND EVER
